description: Verify that SubscribeEventgroupNack echoes Eventgroup ID for unknown EventGroupID
approach:
[Objective]
SubscribeEventgroupNack echoes Eventgroup ID for unknown EventGroupID.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message (OfferService / Subscribe Ack / Nack). The harness captures it and validates the asserted property byte-precisely.

[Pass condition]
The asserted property holds on the wire.

[Fail condition]
Fail_<state> per the listed verdicts; Fail_timeout if no qualifying SD message arrived.

verdicts.Fail_eventgroup_id: Nack entry eventgroup_id not unknown sentinel
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
